Enter your tracking number to instantly trace international container movements and access real-time cargo updates.Carrier(ONE Line) Ocean Network Express (ONE Line) You have 3 / 3 trackings left. and increase your tracking limit.About Ocean Network Express (ONE) container trackingOcean Network Express Pte. Ltd. (ONE) was established in 2016 through the integration of the container shipping divisions of NYK, MOL, and K Line. The company is headquartered in Singapore with regional operations in Tokyo. ONE officially launched in April 2018 and quickly became one of the largest global container shipping companies, with a combined fleet capacity exceeding 1.4 million TEUs. Its fleet includes large modern vessels such as the ONE Columba, ONE Apus, and ONE Infinity, each designed to carry more than 14,000 TEUs with improved fuel efficiency and advanced navigation systems.ONE uses container prefixes like ONEU, NYKU, MOLU, and KKLU to identify its shipments across international routes. The carrier is active on major trade lanes including Asia-North America, Asia-Europe, and intra-Asia, and serves major ports across all continents. The company has implemented sustainable practices such as low-sulfur fuel and energy-saving technologies in compliance with IMO environmental regulations.We offer Ocean Network Express container tracking that provides real-time shipment updates across a single, integrated dashboard. You can track your ONE containers by entering the container number, Master Bill of Lading (BL), or booking reference. Our system supports full ONE tracking coverage, including ONE container tracking, ONE BL tracking, and ONE shipping tracking. You can also monitor multiple containers in a single view, which is useful for businesses managing bulk shipments.Whether your cargo is moving across Asia, the Pacific, or other global trade routes, you can rely on our system for complete and timely updates on your ONE shipments.Carrier ReliabilityOn-Time Arrival PerformanceOn time arrival record for ONE Line as measured by comparing scheduled arrivals vs actual arrivals of all vessels26.86%Shipments on-time [as on Apr 07 - 2026]100%Chart created using amCharts libraryAverage DelayThe average delay for ONE Line vessels as measured by comparing each vessel’s actual arrival time to its schedule+6.1Average Delay [as on Apr 07 - 2026]100%Chart created using amCharts libraryEmissions InsightsGain insights into ONE Line’s carbon footprint to support and achieve your sustainability goals of 2025 and beyond. Ltd. is an international shipping line headquartered in Singapore and Tokyo. It is jointly owned by the Japanese shipping companies Nippon Yusen Kaisha, Mitsui O.S.K. Lines, and K-Line. The company was founded in 2016, after inheriting the container shipping operations of its parent companies.What does Ocean Network Express do?Ocean Network Express is a Japanese container shipping and transportation business.How accurate is GoComet’s One Line shipment tracking?Our One Line container tracking system provides real-time updates with over 95% accuracy, helping businesses monitor their shipments effortlessly.Is GoComet’s One Line tracking tool free to use?Yes, our tracking tool is free to use and provides instant shipment updates for One Line containers worldwide.How does GoComet’s One Line tracking compare to other tools?With a 4.74-star rating, GoComet is trusted for its intuitive dashboard, automated alerts, and seamless tracking experience.Can I track my One Line container by Bill of Lading (BL) number?Yes, you can track your shipment using the container number, Bill of Lading (BL) number, or booking reference for real-time updates.How do I track and trace ONE line containers?You can track and trace ONE line containers on GoComet's Ocean Network Express tracking tool by simply entering the bill of lading number (Master Bill of Lading, also called MBL). Shippers can also track shipments using the container number or booking number received from the vendor.Why is the ONE Line tracking tool trusted by so many users?ONE Line tracking on GoComet is rated 4.9 with 3017 reviews sourced from G2, Gartner, and monthly internal feedback. Users love its simplicity, quick response time, and consistency in live container tracking.How can I use GoComet’s Ocean Network Express Line container tracking tool?You can use Gocomet’s free ONE shipping line cargo tracking tool to track ONE line shipments by just entering the carrier name and booking number in the respective search boxes.Where do I get the tracking number of my ONE-line shipment?You will need to enter either the booking number of your container, reference number, container number, or the Master Bill of Lading number that comes with the receipt or invoices.When will my ONE line cargo shipment arrive?The ONE cargo delivery arrives in 2-5 business days. However, there can be some delays due to various factors including port congestions. You can use GoComet’s free port congestion database to find out real-time updates on port congestion across the world.Can I track the sailing schedule of the ONE shipping line?You can use GoComet’s free smart schedule platform for all ONE line vessel schedules.What is the container freight rate for ONE shipping line?You can find the ongoing container freight rate of Ocean Network vessels for 20 ft and 40 ft containers on GoComet’s free Freight Rate Calculator platform.Is ONE Line part of a shipping alliance?Yes, ONE is a member of THE Alliance, along with Hapag-Lloyd, Yang Ming, and HMM. This partnership enables shared vessel space and greater frequency on major routes, especially between Asia and North America or Europe.How large is the ONE Line container shipping fleet?ONE operates a fleet of over 200 container vessels, including some of the world’s largest ships with capacities exceeding 20,000 TEUs. The company continues to expand its fleet to serve key global trade lanes.How do I track my Ocean Network shipments without a booking number?You can enter the container number or master bill of lading, and carrier name on the tracking ONE line platform to view your shipment updates.Why is my ONE line shipment delayed?There could be many reasons for ONE delivery delays. Port congestion is one such factor, and other factors may include custom clearance issues, failed delivery attempts, or invalid or insufficient documents.What should I do if my ONE Line shipment is delayed?If your ONE Line shipment is delayed, GoComet provides several tools to help you take control of the situation. Begin by checking real-time port conditions using our Port Congestion Tracking Tool, which shows delays and vessel wait times at major ports worldwide. This can help you determine if the delay is due to congestion, port inefficiencies, or external disruptions. Next, use GoTrack to monitor your container's exact location, view historical movement, and get an accurate ETA. GoTrack consolidates tracking data into one platform, saving you time and reducing guesswork. To manage communication and internal coordination during the delay, GoShipment keeps all stakeholders aligned through automated task tracking, notifications, and shipment-specific updates. These tools work together to minimize the impact of delays, improve decision-making, and ensure you're always one step ahead in your supply chain operations.Can I manage multiple ONE Line shipments from one platform?Yes, using GoTrack, you can monitor multiple ONE Line containers from a single dashboard. This feature helps logistics teams manage large volumes efficiently and improve supply chain visibility.
